title: College Football Simulator SimCFB
author: SimCFB
selftext:
[www.simCFB.com](http://www.simcfb.com/)

Releasing Version 1.0 today. Works on both mobile and desktop.

Been working on this as a personal project for quite a while. Have no plans of monetizing it. Just wanted to build it because it is something I've wanted to do for a long time. Not even sure people will enjoy playing it or not. I made it the way I would have liked to play.

Everything can be micromanaged or auto managed (CPU decides for you). You can call the plays or you can have the CPU coach call the plays. You can micro manage recruiting or recruit yourself.

There is a lot of emphasis on the NIL portal.

Looking forward to feedback. If you experience any bugs let me know.

Right now only the Power 4 conference teams are playable.

comments.author: Yo-Soy-Groot
comments.body: What model are you using for the sim? Jev?

replies.author: SimCFB
replies.body: I used Claude Code primarily and a bit of codex.

replies.author: Yo-Soy-Groot
replies.body: Sorry i meant what's driving the play calling of the sim AI?

replies.author: SimCFB
replies.body:
Oh just regular algorithms. No AI.

I played around with neural nets to control the players. But it never panned out. Simpler algorithms do a more reliable job of simulating football. At least based on what I experienced.
